summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Corgi QBTS 2x Daily ETF (QUA) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund aims to provide 2x leveraged exposure to the daily price movement, less fees and expenses, of D-Wave Quantum, Inc. shares (Ticker: QBTS) through the use of derivatives. QUA was launched on Jul 10, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.
